mapper.select: SELECT S.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME FROM SUBCATEGORY S JOIN CATEGORY C ON S.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID WHERE C.CATEGORY_NAME = #{categoryName}

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 16 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.PRODUCT_EXPLANATION, P.PRODUCT_KEYWORD, U.NAME AS SELLER_NAME FROM PRODUCT P JOIN USERS_TB U ON P.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT FILE_ID AS fileId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, SAVED_NAME AS savedName, FILE_PATH AS filePath, IS_MAIN AS isMain FROM PRODUCT_FILE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY IS_MAIN DESC, FILE_ID ASC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE UPPER(P.PRODUCT_TITLE) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR UPPER(P.PRODUCT_KEYWORD) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.USER_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, F.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID AND F.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME IN ( SELECT S.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME FROM SUBCATEGORY S JOIN CATEGORY C ON S.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID WHERE C.CATEGORY_NAME = #{category} UNION SELECT #{category} FROM DUAL ) ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC
SELECT C.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUB_CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY C LEFT JOIN SUBCATEGORY S ON S.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY C.CATEGORY_ID, S.SUB_CATEGORY_ID
